items.claim: Vitor Petrino has strong legs that allow him to keep his base and keep the fight standing against grapplers.
items.quote: Petrino's got, you know, tree trunks for legs. I think he's able to keep his base and keep the fight standing.

items.claim: Serghei Spivac has been knocked out four times in his career.
items.quote: Spivac's been knocked out four times. Uh Gone, Almeida, Aspinall, Walt Harris.

items.claim: Vitor Petrino is able to maintain his power while fighting at a 15-minute pace at heavyweight.
items.quote: I'm still throwing hard, but at least I'm conditioned to throw relatively hard and, you know, stay on the feet with you for 15 straight minutes.

items.claim: Anthony Hernandez suffered a TKO loss to Sean Strickland where Strickland broke him down and finished him in the third round.
items.quote: Eventually Strickland TKOs Fluffy in the third round after a very dominant third round in the 2 minutes in which in that round.
